item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena fills a balloon with air and ties its mouth tightly. She then places the balloon inside a freezer for some time.

The balloon shrinks slightly.

What happens to the density of the air inside the balloon?

options.A: It increases, because cooling brings the air particles closer together, reducing the volume.
options.B: It decreases, because cooling always decreases the density of a gas.
options.C: It stays the same, because the amount of air in the balloon does not change.
options.D: It becomes zero, because cooling stops the movement of air particles.
